title: Remove Duplicates from Sorted Array
statement: Write `remove_duplicates(arr)` for a sorted list. Remove duplicates in place so each unique value appears once at the front. Return the count of unique values. The values beyond that count may be anything.

predict_steps.prompt: Slow points at last unique write. When fast sees a new value, what happens?
predict_steps.answer: slow advances and writes the new value
